context: ministration: Directions: For best results, use at first sign of symptoms. Adults and children 12 years of age and older: Take 2 teaspoons (10 mL) four times daily. Children 6-11 years of age: take 1 teaspoon (5 mL) four times daily. Children under 6 years of age: Ask a doctor.
